nominal private x_t_referencia = string

inl x_t_referencia_is_valid (s : string) : bool =
    xsd_regex.table_matches (xsd_pattern_0f8375cb_11_table ()) s
    && xml.code_point_count s >= 1
    && xml.code_point_count s <= 250

inl x_t_referencia_of_string (s : string) : option x_t_referencia =
    match xml.collapsed_space s with s => if x_t_referencia_is_valid s then Some (x_t_referencia s) else None

inl x_t_referencia_to_string (x : x_t_referencia) : string = match x with x_t_referencia s => s

instance to_text x_t_referencia = fun x => x_t_referencia_to_string x
inl x_t_referencia_example (_ : i32) : x_t_referencia = x_t_referencia "A"

inl x_t_referencia_example_text (k : i32) : string = x_t_referencia_to_string (x_t_referencia_example k)

nominal x_timbre_fiscal_digital =
    {
        version : string
        uuid : x_timbre_fiscal_digital_uuid
        fecha_timbrado : x_t_fecha_h
        rfc_prov_certif : x_t_rfc_pm
        leyenda : option (x_timbre_fiscal_digital_leyenda)
        sello_cfd : x_timbre_fiscal_digital_sello_cfd
        no_certificado_sat : x_timbre_fiscal_digital_no_certificado_sat
        sello_sat : x_timbre_fiscal_digital_sello_sat
    }

let rec x_timbre_fiscal_digital_of_children
    (attributes : list (string * string)) (children : list xml.xml_node)
    : result (x_timbre_fiscal_digital) (list xml_codec.decode_error)
    =
    inl errors = []
    inl v_version, errors = xml_codec.attribute_required "Version" attributes errors
    inl errors = xml_codec.fixed_checked "Version" "1.1" attributes errors
    inl o_uuid, errors = xml_codec.attribute_parsed x_timbre_fiscal_digital_uuid_of_string "UUID" attributes errors
    inl o_fecha_timbrado, errors = xml_codec.attribute_parsed x_t_fecha_h_of_string "FechaTimbrado" attributes errors
    inl o_rfc_prov_certif, errors = xml_codec.attribute_parsed x_t_rfc_pm_of_string "RfcProvCertif" attributes errors
    inl v_leyenda, errors =
        xml_codec.attribute_optional_parsed x_timbre_fiscal_digital_leyenda_of_string "Leyenda" attributes errors
    inl v_sello_cfd, errors = xml_codec.attribute_required "SelloCFD" attributes errors
    inl o_no_certificado_sat, errors =
        xml_codec.attribute_parsed x_timbre_fiscal_digital_no_certificado_sat_of_string
            "NoCertificadoSAT"
            attributes
            errors
    inl v_sello_sat, errors = xml_codec.attribute_required "SelloSAT" attributes errors
    xml_codec.decoded_by errors fun () =>
        x_timbre_fiscal_digital {
            version = v_version
            uuid = xml_codec.present o_uuid
            fecha_timbrado = xml_codec.present o_fecha_timbrado
            rfc_prov_certif = xml_codec.present o_rfc_prov_certif
            leyenda = v_leyenda
            sello_cfd = v_sello_cfd
            no_certificado_sat = xml_codec.present o_no_certificado_sat
            sello_sat = v_sello_sat
        }

and let x_timbre_fiscal_digital_of_xml (c : xml.xml_node) : result (x_timbre_fiscal_digital) (list xml_codec.decode_error) =
    x_timbre_fiscal_digital_of_children (xml.element_attributes c) (xml.element_children c)

and let x_timbre_fiscal_digital_children (x : x_timbre_fiscal_digital) : list xml.xml_node = []

and let x_timbre_fiscal_digital_attributes (x : x_timbre_fiscal_digital) : list (string * string) =
    listm.concat [
        [ ("Version", x.version) ]
        [ ("UUID", to_text x.uuid) ]
        [ ("FechaTimbrado", to_text x.fecha_timbrado) ]
        [ ("RfcProvCertif", to_text x.rfc_prov_certif) ]
        xml.option_list (optionm.map (fun v => "Leyenda", to_text v) x.leyenda)
        [ ("SelloCFD", x.sello_cfd) ]
        [ ("NoCertificadoSAT", to_text x.no_certificado_sat) ]
        [ ("SelloSAT", x.sello_sat) ]
    ]

and let x_timbre_fiscal_digital_to_xml (name : string) (x : x_timbre_fiscal_digital) : xml.xml_node =
    xml.element name (x_timbre_fiscal_digital_attributes x) (x_timbre_fiscal_digital_children x)
